concerns.text: Task T030 implements a hard failure (FileNotFoundError) if manual annotations are missing, directly contradicting spec.md SC-005 which explicitly allows an 'expert review report' as a fallback. This leaves the Success Criterion SC-005 unimplementable if the dataset lacks manual annotations, as no task exists to generate the expert review report.

Task T032 mandates calculating confidence intervals using residuals from the 'validation set' to predict test set uncertainty. However, spec.md FR-008 and SC-004 require quantifying uncertainty for the 'test set' predictions. No task exists to calculate residuals specifically on the test set or to implement the test-set-based confidence interval logic required by the spec.

Task T042 is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`) and was previously rejected in the analyze report for failing to produce the required `results/validation_report.json` and exit logic. No revised task or alternative task exists to fulfill the data validation requirement (FR-001, US-1) for checking invalid pairs and exiting on >1% invalid ratio.

Task T007 is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`) and was previously rejected for failing to produce required log files (`results/metrics.log`, `results/metrics.json`). No revised task exists to fulfill the logging requirement for the foundational phase, blocking downstream tasks that depend on this infrastructure.

Tasks T048, T024, and T052 correctly identify and attempt to fix the 'paired t-test' vs 'single-sample t-test' contradiction between plan.md and spec.md. However, the plan.md artifact itself (which these tasks reference) still contains the incorrect 'paired t-test' description in the Summary and Constitution Check. A task is missing to explicitly update the plan.md text to match the spec, leaving the plan artifact in a contradictory state.
